features.name: Session briefing on demand
features.description: Any project asks 'what is my current state and what should I know?' and gets back the latest project state, the most relevant recent decisions, and any pending reviews — trimmed to a token budget.
features.notes: qi_get_context; ranks same-project items first, then ecosystem-wide; default 2000-token budget, 14-day window

features.name: Decision ledger
features.description: Every significant architectural or process decision is recorded with its rationale, who made it, and how widely it applies, so it can be recalled and never silently re-litigated.
features.notes: 491 active decisions; scope = project | ecosystem | global

features.name: Supersede, never delete
features.description: When a decision is reversed, the old one is marked superseded by the new one with a reason — the history stays intact and explainable.
features.notes: qi_supersede_decision; superseded decisions drop out of context but remain queryable

features.name: Session history
features.description: Each working session is logged with a summary, what changed, how many decisions/features it produced, and the model used — a chronological record of the whole ecosystem's work.
features.notes: 565 sessions logged across all projects

features.name: Project state tracking
features.description: Every project's current phase, status, blockers and next steps are kept current, giving a one-glance view of where everything stands.
features.notes: 239 state snapshots; status = active | paused | blocked | complete

features.name: Feature propagation engine
features.description: When a useful pattern is discovered in one project, the Brain automatically asks 'is this relevant to each other project?' and records an adopt / adapt / skip / discuss recommendation for each.
features.notes: Local qwen3:8b evaluates relevance per target project; 394 features, 44 evaluations recorded

features.name: Pending-review queue
features.description: Recommendations the Brain makes are queued for the owner to confirm, so good ideas surface for a decision rather than being lost.
features.notes: qi_get_pending_features; 44 awaiting review

features.name: Owner override (Law 6)
features.description: The owner can override any of the Brain's automated recommendations with their own call and a reason — the human decision is always final.
features.notes: evaluation_overrides table + qi_override_evaluation wired; 0 used so far

features.name: Learns from its own history
features.description: Each relevance evaluation is shown the last few decisions made for that target project, so its recommendations stay consistent with how that project has actually decided before.
features.notes: Last 5 evaluations injected as soft context per target

features.name: Search memory by meaning
features.description: Ask in plain English — 'have we dealt with concurrent database writes before?' — and the Brain returns the closest decisions, features, sessions or documents, even without matching keywords.
features.notes: qi_search_memory over 4 ChromaDB collections; cosine similarity

features.name: Explain anything
features.description: Get a clean, readable writeup of any decision, feature, session or project — including its rationale, scope, and whether it was later superseded.
features.notes: qi_explain returns markdown + citations

features.name: Free local embeddings
features.description: All semantic memory is built with a local embedding model, so search costs nothing to run and needs no external API.
features.notes: nomic-embed-text via Ollama; 768-dim vectors

features.name: Background poller
features.description: The Brain reads each project's state file and recent git commits on a schedule, keeping itself up to date even when no one remembers to push an update.
features.notes: Every 300s; 18,718 poll cycles logged

features.name: File inbox
features.description: Any tool or service can drop a JSON message in the Brain's inbox folder; the poller picks it up and files it, no API call required.
features.notes: C:\QIH\engine\brain\inbox\*.json

features.name: Documentation Brain
features.description: Every document across the ecosystem is catalogued and linked into a knowledge graph, so 'where is the doc on X?' has a single answer.
features.notes: 921 docs indexed, 2,203 relationship edges; powers the hive-librarian agent

features.name: Agent registry & heartbeats
features.description: Every QI agent — Claude, the 7 Hive sub-agents, and the sibling services — is registered, and the Brain tracks when each was last active.
features.notes: 14 agents registered; 1,643 heartbeats; powers the War Room presence board

features.name: Dispatch pipeline
features.description: Work items (build this, review that) flow through the Brain as dispatches with status, priority, and an apply-state, coordinating the Hive's autonomous build/review loop.
features.notes: 2,873 dispatches; 7 dispatch runs tracked

features.name: Compliance log
features.description: Every standards finding the Inspector raises across the ecosystem is recorded here with severity and whether it was auto-fixed.
features.notes: 46,654 compliance-log rows

features.name: Agent growth loop
features.description: Agents record what they learned after a task, building a profile of each agent's accumulated patterns over time.
features.notes: POST /api/agent/growth; surfaced via /api/agent/{id}/profile

features.name: War Room chat
features.description: A shared message board where agents post to each other, persisted in the Brain so the conversation survives restarts.
features.notes: warroom_messages; 11 messages so far

features.name: 12-tool MCP server
features.description: The Brain exposes its whole capability set as 12 MCP tools any Claude session can call directly, with no code changes per project.
features.notes: mcp.py stdio bridge; registered globally in claude.json

features.name: Plain REST API
features.description: Non-Claude callers get the same operations over standard HTTP, with health, version and info probes for monitoring.
features.notes: FastAPI on :9011; /health, /version, /info, /docs

features.name: 24/7 Windows service
features.description: Runs unattended as the QI_BrainAPI service so the ecosystem's memory is always available.
features.notes: NSSM QI_BrainAPI; AppDirectory C:\QIH; logs to qi_brain_api.log

features.name: Open CORS for QI services
features.description: Any QI project — current or future — can call the Brain from a browser without per-project allow-listing.
features.notes: CORS allow_origins=* (local-only deployment)

features.name: Authentication & multi-user
features.description: Token auth and per-caller isolation for use beyond the local machine.
features.notes: Currently local-only behind the QI service boundary; no auth layer yet
